text: New Era Cap is privately owned by its original founding family, the Kochs of Buffalo, New York, and led by fourth-generation CEO Chris Koch. In August 2022 ACON Investments closed a roughly $700 million continuation round for New Era Cap under which the NFL, NBA and MLB all became minority investors.
short: New Era Cap is the Koch family's private company; the NFL, NBA and MLB took minority stakes in 2022.

source.name: Reuters via Yahoo Finance: U.S. sports league caps maker New Era prepares for IPO, sources say
